newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt realty firm goes majority private.
newsitem.headline: Egypt realty firm goes majority private.

text.p: The Holding Company for Housing, Tourism and Cinema has sold all its stake in Development and Engineering Consultancy for a total 32.3 million pounds ($9.52 million), the sale agents said on Wednesday.
Mohammed Hossny, vice president of Triple A Securities, told Reuters the state firm had sold all its 883,659 shares to private investors for 36.5 pounds a share.
The sale will transfer the company's status to private holding from public holding.
"The firm now is approximately 60 percent privately-owned. The state though still owns a stake," Hossny said.

Hossny said the offer of 350,000 shares or 10 percent of Development and Engineering Consultancy was about 6.5 times oversubscribed. The shares went on sale for two days last week and the minimum bid price was 32.92 pounds ($9.70).
